result.title: NFMap: Topographic 2D Manifold Learning with Invertible Normalizing Flows
result.summary: We present NFMap, a dimensionality reduction method for 2D visualisation that extends Generative Topographic Mapping (GTM) with a bijective normalizing flow. Like GTM, NFMap places a fixed mixture grid prior over a 2D latent map, giving a parametric embedding, an explicit likelihood, and the ability to project new points onto an existing map; the likelihood is an effective out-of-distribution signal on chemical datasets. Unlike GTM, whose latent-to-data mapping is an RBF network of bounded flexibility, NFMap's mapping is a normalizing flow, and is therefore fully invertible: any location on the map can be carried back to data space. To alleviate map crowding on large datasets, NFMap additionally supports heavy-tailed Student-t mixture components. NFMap maps data to a latent space of the same dimension, split into a 2-dimensional navigable map and an off-manifold residual. Because the flow is bijective and its objective penalises volume contraction, variance squeezed out of the residual must reappear in the navigable map. The residual scale is the main control between local neighbourhood fidelity and global distance fidelity; its effect depends on the dimensionality of the data and is coupled to the extent of the latent grid.

AI.brief_summary: NFMap 是一种降维可视化方法，用可逆 normalizing flow 扩展 GTM：在 2D 网格先验上学习参数化嵌入，并给出显式似然；其潜空间分为 2 维可导航地图与 off-manifold 残差，还支持重尾 Student-t 混合成分以缓解地图拥挤。
AI.relevance_reason: 可逆映射与体积收缩惩罚迫使被残差挤出的方差回流到可视流形，这一「局部邻域保真 vs 全局距离保真」的取舍可能启发对 LVR 内部状态中细节保留与几何结构的理解，其似然作为分布外信号也可供核查是否能类比为证据或停止决策信号；但属较远领域，联系仅为概念层面。
